title: Incident Report: Deep Ward
author: Dr. Ines Calloway, Mission campus
pages: Patient: T. Vance, index case. Presenting: burns to both hands, fever, grey striping along the veins. Exposure:

unprotected contact with the inner chamber of the ridge debris. Course: rapid, aggressive from day three.

Transmission by bite and by blood. Antibiotics slow the secondary infection only. No cure found.

All patients exposed to the index case moved to the deep ward, sealed on the generator plant's circuit.

Recommendation: if the plant is ever restored, the deep-ward doors will release.
Do not restore it without an armed team in the corridor. He is still in there.
